notes.title: Bug fixes (trial version) 2022/10/19
notes.notes:
2022/10/19

・Fixed a problem in which the decision key could be pressed even if the user did not have the item in his/her possession, and the game would be interrupted when the item was used.

・Fixed a bug in which the tutorial could not be completed if certain items were used or consumed at the start of the game.
